answer: SELECT c.coordopsref AS opsregistry, d.affectedarea, ROUND((0.6 * (10 * COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'casualties')::numeric, 0) + 3 * COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'injured')::numeric, 0) + 2 * COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'missing')::numeric, 0) + COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'displaced')::numeric, 0)) + 0.4 * ((COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'infra_damage_pct')::numeric, 0) + COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'power_outage_pct')::numeric, 0) + COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'water_damage_pct')::numeric, 0)) / 3)), 2) AS dsi FROM coordinationandevaluation c JOIN operations o ON o.opsregistry = c.coordopsref JOIN disasterevents d ON d.distregistry = c.coord_dist_ref WHERE (0.6 * (10 * COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'casualties')::numeric, 0) + 3 * COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'injured')::numeric, 0) + 2 * COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'missing')::numeric, 0) + COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'displaced')::numeric, 0)) + 0.4 * ((COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'infra_damage_pct')::numeric, 0) + COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'power_outage_pct')::numeric, 0) + COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'water_damage_pct')::numeric, 0)) / 3)) > 15000
note: operations have no disaster FK; linked op->disaster via coordinationandevaluation (op,dist) pairs

answer: SELECT ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(f.ops_costs_usd, 0) + COALESCE(f.transportcostsusd, 0) + COALESCE(f.storage_costs_usd, 0) + COALESCE(f.personnelcostsusd, 0))::numeric / NULLIF(SUM((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'affected')::numeric), 0), 2) AS cost_per_beneficiary FROM operations o JOIN financials f ON f.fin_ops_ref = o.opsregistry JOIN disasterevents d ON d.distregistry = f.findistref WHERE o.opsstatus = 'Completed'

SELECT d.distregistry, d.haztype, d.affectedarea, ROUND(LEAST((s.foodtons * 1000)::numeric / NULLIF((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'affected')::numeric * 2, 0), s.water_liters::numeric / NULLIF((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'affected')::numeric * 3, 0)), 2) AS supply_sufficiency_days, ROUND(GREATEST(0, (d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'displaced')::numeric - s.shelter_units), 2) AS shelter_gap FROM disasterevents d JOIN supplies s ON s.supply_dist_ref = d.distregistry

SELECT d.distregistry, d.affectedarea FROM disasterevents d LEFT JOIN humanresources h ON h.hrdistref = d.distregistry WHERE (COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'casualties')::numeric, 0) + COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'injured')::numeric, 0)) > 100 OR ((h.staffing_details->'staff_counts'->>'medical')::numeric / NULLIF(COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'casualties')::numeric, 0) + COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'injured')::numeric, 0), 0)) < 0.01
note: medical personnel from humanresources; null casualties/injured treated as 0

answer: SELECT o.opsregistry, d.affectedarea, ROUND(((10 - CASE o.priority_rank::text WHEN 'Critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'High' THEN 2 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'Low' THEN 4 END) * 0.5 + COALESCE((h.staffing_details->'staff_counts'->>'total')::numeric, 0) * 0.2 + 1.0 * 30)::numeric, 2) AS gridlock_severity_index FROM operations o JOIN coordinationandevaluation c ON c.coordopsref = o.opsregistry JOIN disasterevents d ON d.distregistry = c.coord_dist_ref LEFT JOIN humanresources h ON h.hr_ops_ref = o.opsregistry WHERE o.supply_flow_state = 'Disrupted' AND d.impact_summary->'communication_and_transport'->>'transport_access' = 'Minimal' ORDER BY gridlock_severity_index DESC
note: op->disaster via coordinationandevaluation; total_personnel from humanresources staff_counts.total (missing -> 0)

answer: SELECT DISTINCT c.* FROM operations o JOIN coordinationandevaluation c ON c.coordopsref = o.opsregistry JOIN beneficiariesandassessments b ON b.beneopsref = c.coordopsref AND b.bene_dist_ref = c.coord_dist_ref JOIN transportation t ON t.transportdistref = c.coord_dist_ref WHERE o.opsstatus = 'Completed' AND (((t.delivery_metrics->'delivery_capacity'->>'daily_tons')::numeric / NULLIF(t.vehiclecount, 0)) < 1.0 OR (0.4 * (t.delivery_metrics->'delivery_performance'->>'success_rate')::numeric + 0.3 * b.bene_feedbackscore * 10 + 0.3 * b.distequityidx * 100) < 40)

WITH dsi AS (SELECT d.distregistry, 0.6 * (10 * COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'casualties')::numeric, 0) + 3 * COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'injured')::numeric, 0) + 2 * COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'missing')::numeric, 0) + COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'displaced')::numeric, 0)) + 0.4 * ((COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'infra_damage_pct')::numeric, 0) + COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'power_outage_pct')::numeric, 0) + COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'water_damage_pct')::numeric, 0)) / 3) AS dsi FROM disasterevents d), hub AS (SELECT h.hubregistry, 0.5 * ((h.hubutilpct::numeric / 100) + (h.stockturnrate::numeric / 10)) + 0.5 * AVG(x.dsi) AS hsi FROM distributionhubs h JOIN transportation t ON t.transport_hub_ref = h.hubregistry JOIN dsi x ON x.distregistry = t.transportdistref GROUP BY h.hubregistry, h.hubutilpct, h.stockturnrate) SELECT hubregistry, ROUND(hsi, 2) AS hsi, CASE WHEN hsi > 1000000 THEN 'Overwhelmed' ELSE 'Normal' END AS status FROM hub

WITH x AS (SELECT o.opsregistry, f.funding_state, REPLACE(REPLACE(f.budgetallotusd, '$', ''), ',', '')::numeric AS budget, (COALESCE(f.ops_costs_usd, 0) + COALESCE(f.transportcostsusd, 0) + COALESCE(f.storage_costs_usd, 0) + COALESCE(f.personnelcostsusd, 0))::numeric AS total_cost, (CURRENT_DATE - o.ops_start_date) AS days FROM operations o JOIN financials f ON f.fin_ops_ref = o.opsregistry WHERE o.opsstatus = 'Active'), r AS (SELECT opsregistry, funding_state, (budget - total_cost) / NULLIF(total_cost / NULLIF(days, 0), 0) AS runway FROM x) SELECT opsregistry, funding_state, ROUND(runway, 1) AS budget_runway_days FROM r WHERE funding_state = 'Critical' AND runway < 7
note: 'ongoing' taken as opsstatus='Active'; total operational costs = sum of the four cost columns

answer: WITH s AS (SELECT c.coordopsref AS opsregistry, 0.4 * (t.delivery_metrics->'delivery_performance'->>'success_rate')::numeric + 0.3 * b.bene_feedbackscore::numeric * 10 + 0.3 * b.distequityidx::numeric * 100 AS res, (c.report_compliance::numeric + c.stakeholder_satisf::numeric * 20 + c.dataqualityvalue * 20) / 3.0 AS cqi FROM coordinationandevaluation c JOIN beneficiariesandassessments b ON b.beneopsref = c.coordopsref AND b.bene_dist_ref = c.coord_dist_ref JOIN transportation t ON t.transportdistref = c.coord_dist_ref) SELECT opsregistry, res, cqi FROM s WHERE res > 75 AND cqi > 75 ORDER BY res DESC

WITH p AS (SELECT h.hr_ops_ref AS opsregistry, ((1 - (h.staffing_details->'staff_counts'->>'medical')::numeric / NULLIF(COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'casualties')::numeric, 0) + COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'injured')::numeric, 0), 0)) * 40) + (CASE e.health_environment_profile->'health'->>'disease_risk' WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END * 10) + ((100 - (e.health_environment_profile->'environment'->>'sanitation_coverage')::numeric) * 0.15) + ((100 - SPLIT_PART(e.health_environment_profile->'environment'->>'water_quality_index', ' ', 1)::numeric) * 0.15) AS phrs FROM humanresources h JOIN disasterevents d ON d.distregistry = h.hrdistref JOIN environmentandhealth e ON e.env_dist_ref = h.hrdistref) SELECT opsregistry, ROUND(phrs, 2) AS phrs FROM p WHERE phrs > 70
